tokens.name: persimmon
tokens.usage: YWCA's persimmon as used on the official site, ywca.org. A fill color first: buttons, tiles, bands, link underlines, and the one bar that carries a chart's point. As type, only for headings and big numbers at 24px and up, or bold at 19px and up, because it measures 3.5 to 1 against a white page. Never beside gray-10 (2.96 to 1).

tokens.name: on-persimmon
tokens.usage: The safe text color on persimmon fills at any size: black, 6.0 to 1. Footer addresses, links, and small labels use it.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Primary brand color. Body text, links, small text on persimmon, half of a two-color headline, caption blocks under photos, the newsletter band, Quick Escape, the focus ring.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Primary brand color. Page and report background, and text over black. Over a persimmon fill, white is for large type and the logo only: 24px and up, or bold at 19px and up. That pair measures 3.5 to 1, which meets AA for large text and fails it for body text. Smaller text over persimmon uses on-persimmon.

tokens.name: gray-10
tokens.usage: The panel gray on ywca.org. Quiet panel fills, card grounds, notices.

tokens.name: gray-20
tokens.usage: The brand gray (Pantone Cool Gray 5, hex as printed in the brand guide). Hairlines between table rows, gridlines, the short rule above a value heading. Decoration only. It measures 1.6 to 1 against a white page, so never text, never a chart mark, never a field border.

tokens.name: gray-50
tokens.usage: 50% black. Chart bars and lines that give context beside the persimmon one. Meets the 3 to 1 minimum for graphics against a white page (3.9 to 1). Not for text.

tokens.name: gray-60
tokens.usage: 60% black. Secondary text on white (5.7:1) and gray-10 (4.8:1), and form field borders on white.

tokens.name: gray-80
tokens.usage: 80% black. A second chart series when two things must be named.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Default surface behind everything.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default text on ground and gray-10.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, labels, and footnotes on ground and gray-10.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Dividers and chart gridlines on ground.

families.display: "avenir-next-pro-heav", "Avenir Next", "Avenir Next Pro", "Arial Black", Arial, sans-serif
